{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_dup_count = data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {patient_dup_count}')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of sentinel values (-999) in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}')

# Check how many patients have multiple sample_seq (re-tests)
multi_sample_patients = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].nunique().gt(1).sum()
print(f'Number of patients with multiple sample_seq (re-tests): {multi_sample_patients}')

# Check the unique values of assay_batch to confirm unit issue only affects biomarker_final
print(f'Unique assay_batch values: {data["assay_batch"].unique()}')"}
